findings: Creator reopen arriving before its vote or roster was lost; re-encrypted old votes could reactivate after cancellation.
Creator roster/reopen/closing after vote timeout was rejected although upstream uses those controls to resolve timeout.
correction: Durably retain up to 256 cancelled vote IDs without eviction; matching pending vote cleared only after successful encrypted save.
Creator resolution uses original pool deadline and at most upstream 180-second grace. Own vote and closing deadlines remain strict.
No changes to ownership, independent chain checks, output/fee/signature validation, reservations, explicit signing approval or broadcasting.

nodeBaseline.note: 33 new initial cases; 5 further guards and 3 grace-boundary cases added subsequently.

hermes.coverage: 12 actual Kotlin startup fixtures × (6 replay orders + 3 timeout resolutions); final timeout-roster cases additionally assert grace expiry. Both scripts, 2/5 participants, 1/2/5 outputs. Unchanged journal/reservations and zero spending signatures checked.
